use std::{cell::RefCell, path::Path};
use codegen_runtime::{ExecutionContext, RuntimeParameters, Value, PrimarySourceHost, PrimaryFileSelection, CsvSourceData, PrimaryEdiDocumentError, EdiBoundaryError, RuntimeError, PrimaryAcquisitionError};
use ferrule_generated_mapping::{execute_primary_edi_document_bytes, evaluate_output_filename};

const INPUT_NODE: u32 = __INPUT_NODE__;
const OUTPUT_NODE: u32 = __OUTPUT_NODE__;
const EXPECTED: &[u8] = b"{\n  \"label\": \"blue widget\",\n  \"units\": \"7\"\n}\n";

#[derive(Default)]
struct Host { calls: RefCell<Vec<String>>, count: Option<usize>, malformed: bool }
impl PrimarySourceHost for Host {
    type Error = std::io::Error;
    fn select(&self, filename: &str, selection: PrimaryFileSelection) -> Result<Vec<String>, Self::Error> {
        assert_eq!(selection, PrimaryFileSelection::Direct);
        self.calls.borrow_mut().push(format!("select:{filename}"));
        Ok((0..self.count.unwrap_or(1)).map(|_| filename.to_string()).collect())
    }
    fn load(&self, request: &str) -> Result<CsvSourceData, Self::Error> {
        self.calls.borrow_mut().push(format!("load:{request}"));
        Ok(CsvSourceData { bytes: if self.malformed { b"not an HL7 message".to_vec() } else { b"MSH|^~\\&|\rABC|blue widget|7\r".to_vec() }, resolved_path: None })
    }
}

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    for (input, output, expected) in [
        (Some(" ./input.hl7 "), Some(" ./output.json "), None),
        (None, Some("output.json"), Some("InputFile")),
        (Some("input.hl7"), None, Some("OutputFile")),
        (Some("*.hl7"), Some("output.json"), Some("wildcards")),
        (Some("input.hl7"), Some(""), Some("nonempty")),
        (Some("input.hl7"), Some("*.json"), Some("wildcards")),
    ] {
        let mut parameters = RuntimeParameters::new();
        for (name, value) in [("InputFile", input), ("OutputFile", output)] {
            if let Some(value) = value { parameters.insert(name, Value::String(value.into()))?; }
        }
        let execution = ExecutionContext::new(Path::new("mapping.json")).with_parameters(&parameters);
        let host = Host::default();
        match (execute_primary_edi_document_bytes(&execution, &host, 1), expected) {
            (Ok(bytes), None) => {
                assert_eq!(bytes, EXPECTED);
                assert_eq!(evaluate_output_filename(&execution)?, output.unwrap());
                assert_eq!(*host.calls.borrow(), [format!("select:{}", input.unwrap()), format!("load:{}", input.unwrap())]);
            }
            (Err(PrimaryEdiDocumentError::Acquisition(PrimaryAcquisitionError::Filename(RuntimeError::MissingRuntimeParameter {node, name}))), Some(expected @ ("InputFile" | "OutputFile"))) => {
                assert_eq!(name, expected);
                assert_eq!(node, if expected == "InputFile" { INPUT_NODE } else { OUTPUT_NODE });
                assert!(host.calls.borrow().is_empty());
            }
            (Err(PrimaryEdiDocumentError::Acquisition(PrimaryAcquisitionError::Filename(error @ RuntimeError::InvalidFilenameEndpoint {node}))), Some(_)) => {
                assert_eq!(node, if input == Some("*.hl7") { INPUT_NODE } else { OUTPUT_NODE });
                assert_eq!(error.to_string(), format!("filename endpoint node {node} requires nonempty text without wildcards or control characters"));
                assert!(host.calls.borrow().is_empty());
            }
            other => panic!("unexpected complete outcome: {other:?}"),
        }
    }
    let mut parameters = RuntimeParameters::new();
    parameters.insert("InputFile", Value::String("input.hl7".into()))?;
    parameters.insert("OutputFile", Value::String("output.json".into()))?;
    let execution = ExecutionContext::new(Path::new("mapping.json")).with_parameters(&parameters);
    for count in [0, 2] {
        let host = Host { count: Some(count), ..Default::default() };
        assert!(matches!(execute_primary_edi_document_bytes(&execution, &host, 3), Err(PrimaryEdiDocumentError::Acquisition(PrimaryAcquisitionError::DirectSelection {found})) if found == count));
        assert_eq!(*host.calls.borrow(), ["select:input.hl7"]);
    }
    let host = Host { malformed: true, ..Default::default() };
    assert!(matches!(execute_primary_edi_document_bytes(&execution, &host, 1), Err(PrimaryEdiDocumentError::Acquisition(PrimaryAcquisitionError::Input {path, source: EdiBoundaryError::Format(codegen_runtime::EdiFormatError::NotHl7("stream must start with FHS, BHS, or MSH"))})) if path == "input.hl7"));
    assert_eq!(*host.calls.borrow(), ["select:input.hl7", "load:input.hl7"]);
    Ok(())
}
